summary: Completed mobile responsiveness testing for French web app 'Stratégie & Expertise Santé'. Tested all requested mobile fixes at 375px viewport. All features working correctly: 1) Maladies professionnelles table shows stacked cards on mobile with full disease names, number badges, and délai info - desktop table hidden on mobile. 2) ResourcesPage 7 encyclopedia tabs wrap properly into 3 rows on mobile without overflow. 3) MentionsLegalesPage 3 tabs stack vertically (grid-cols-1) on mobile. 4) PdfCoverPreview modal uses responsive width calculation min(340px, calc(100vw-3rem)). 5) StrategiIA premium options use flex justify-between with whitespace-nowrap badges to prevent text cutoff.
test_credentials: No auth needed for mobile testing
